rationale: Motor vehicle collision with direct damage to the policyholder's vehicle and injury to the policyholder resulting from the collision.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended on Route 9 yesterday at approximately 8:15am by a vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking. Vehicle is totaled (trunk crushed into back seat) and claimant sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Police report filed with other driver's insurance information; $750 deductible applies.

case_facts.description: rear-end collision; other driver going approximately 35 mph with no braking; entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.police_report: filed; other driver's insurance info included
